'''Yūko Kobayashi''' (Japanese: '''小林優子''' ''Kobayashi Yūko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She has worked for the {{pkmn|animated series}} since [[EP001|the first episode]]. Her most significant role is that of [[Gary Oak|Shigeru Okido]] (Gary Oak). She was born on February 6, 1961 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
